lock_mode_before_rebase.meaning: value of the lockMode field set by the onlyGuardian before rebaseOraclePack executes

lock_mode_after_rebase.meaning: value of the lockMode field after rebaseOraclePack executes

assumptions: The lockMode field is a 2-bit encoded value; the report states the guardian-set value as '3' and the post-rebase value as '00'.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who may call rebaseOraclePack or whether the caller is unauthorized; the intent's applicability scope is limited to preservation across rebaseOraclePack execution.

limitations: The correspondence pattern compares the pre-rebase lockMode value (3) with the post-rebase lockMode value; the report's '00' encoding is represented by the post-rebase observable rather than a separate bit-level predicate.
The report does not specify the initial lockMode value before the guardian sets it to '3'; only the guardian-set value is formalized.
